title: Control access to funds data with Focus as a data source
description:
Admins can now manage the inclusion of funds data when connecting Focus as a data source in Atlassian Analytics. This update provides greater control over sensitive financial information by allowing you to choose whether funds-related views are included in your data source. To get started: Go to the Analytics app.
	Create a new data source or select an existing one to edit.
	Select Focus from the list of available apps.
